messages:
Harper: Quick preflight for Velox Systems hardware+NimbusCloud marketplace bundle. Need owners for: hardware SKU bundling, firmware image asset, SI cert badge, joint press embargo, and co-marketing spend signoff. Who can take what?
Luis: I'll own SKU bundling and the offer page metadata. will map hardware SKUs -> sw subscription tiers and upload CSV by 2pm PT.
Nora: marketing will own landing + launch blog. Draft landing + webinar outline by Wed noon. want a short video demo from Velox if possible.
Jade (Velox HW): We can provide firmware images (v2.4.1) and one hero photo. Warning: lead time for sample hardware shipments = 7 business days.
Victor (SI): SI certification status: integration tests pass for baseline flows; need to validate hardware attach flow with Velox firmware. will run combined e2e Wed night.
Mina (Design): I'll make a hardware badge (120x40 PNG + accessible ALT) and hero product crop for the listing. ETA today 6pm.
FinanceBot: co-marketing budget requires partner PO or spend cap. Velox, please confirm PO by Friday to enable paid outreach.
Legal•Tara: embargo proposal 2026-05-12 08:00 PT. partners must sign co-marketing agreement + quote approvals by Tue COB or we do a rolling announcement.
Harper: paste runbook snippet below.
````
RUNBOOK: Velox+Nimbus Marketplace Bundle Preflight
- SKU bundle CSV: owner=Luis, due=Today 2pm PT, sheet=marketplace/velox_offers.csv
- Firmware image & hero photo: owner=Jade (Velox), deliver v2.4.1.bin + hero.jpg by Wed 10am PT
- SI e2e test (hardware attach): owner=Victor, run=Wed 22:00 PT, report=drive/si/velox_e2e.log
- Badge spec + listing hero: owner=Mina (Design), 120x40 PNG + SVG, due=Today 6pm PT
- Marketing assets (landing, blog, webinar): owner=Nora, draft due=Wed 12pm PT
- Co-marketing PO: owner=Velox‒Jade, confirm by Fri COB
- Embargo signoff & quote approvals: owner=Legal•Tara, confirm by Tue COB
- Staging push: owner=PlatformOps, scheduled=2026-05-11 23:00 PT
- Dry run: 30min preflight call 2026-05-12 07:00 PT (ops+infra+partner)
````
Luis: note on redirects: we'll have promo trial links that need 301s to live bundles post-embargo. I'll prepare redirect rules.
Jade (Velox HW): Firmware packaging note: please host binaries on secure CDN with expiring presigned URLs. can Redwood staging accept presigned links?
Victor (SI): yes, staging supports presigned URLs; will test download + verify checksum in the e2e.
Mina (Design): uploading badge + hero comp -> https://drive.redwood/marketplace/velox (files: badge_v2.png, hero_crop.jpg). ALT text: "Velox certified on Redwood Inference"
Nora: marketing Q: CTA — Buy hardware bundle vs Start free trial? suggest primary = Request demo (hardware lead gen), secondary = Start free trial for software-only flows.
Harper: agree. hardware listings should default to Request demo. we'll expose trial for software-only SKU variants.
FinanceBot: tagging finance: partner-managed billing for hardware requires tax id + PO number. Velox please provide.
Legal•Tara: small legal note: any Velox quote must be returned with partner comms approval. if not, we'll redact until signed.
LaunchBot: reminder: schema validator runs at 22:30 PT. missing canonical tags or firmware file links will block the push.
Victor (SI): I'll post the e2e run result in the sheet. if hardware attach fails, we push the dry run to Thurs same time.
Harper: please ack with :white_check_mark: when your row is updated. we'll run the preflight tomorrow 07:00 PT.
Luis: :white_check_mark:
Mina (Design): :white_check_mark:
Jade (Velox HW): :white_check_mark:
Victor (SI): :white_check_mark:
